crew.overview: A myriad of outrageous calamities befalls an eccentric English clan with more than a few skeletons in its closets when the family's patriarch dies an unexpected death.
crew.title: Death at a Funeral

crew.original_title: Doctor Who: The Day of the Doctor
crew.overview: In 2013, something terrible is awakening in London's National Gallery; in 1562, a murderous plot is afoot in Elizabethan England; and somewhere in space an ancient battle reaches its devastating conclusion. All of reality is at stake as the Doctor's own dangerous past comes back to haunt him.
crew.title: Doctor Who: The Day of the Doctor

details.biography: Murray Gold is an English film and TV composer. He is known for his repeated collaboration with writer and showrunner Russell T. Davies and for his scoring work on the revived BBC science fiction series 'Doctor Who', for which he wrote score for the first ten seasons, even after Davies left the series as showrunner in 2009 and handed over the reigns to Steven Moffat.
details.name: Murray Gold
